descriptions.text: Enchanted Hammer of Fast Forward. This is a small hammer. It's enchanted. That means it's magical. It just doesn't do anything magical.

beats.headline: Borant appealed, and lost
beats.text: Five hours before the Butcher's Masquerade, five Apothecary sponsorship boxes sit on one table, given to five different crawlers, all with notes saying they belong to Donut. Imani's held a ball peen hammer that fits in Carl's hand, and she was told Borant had filed a dangerous appeal to keep it from arriving, an appeal immediately denied. The box was only silver. Why give it to Donut, Carl asks, when she cannot even use it: is she supposed to hold it in her mouth? Mordecai has seen it before. Some items are enchanted with no properties, which lets them be used against things like ghosts. After finding a seven on the stick, Carl looks at the hammer again, and along its wooden handle is another.

beats.headline: One very tiny tap
beats.text: Five minutes on the timer in the seventh floor's starting chamber. Prepotente asks Donut for the hammer and the magical stick, lays them on the ground by the back wall and goes to a knee; he still does not understand why they were given to her and not him. When the countdown has dropped to zero and the stick is halfway into the glass, he picks up the hammer and whispers that he is a good, smart boy. He gives the stick a very tiny tap. A lightning pattern of fissures spreads across the wall. Then every wall of the level shatters into fine dust.
